about: The Workbench icons of the InertiaBlast drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/inertiablast.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: the ship lifting the energy pod on its tractor beam) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/inertiablast.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. InertiaBlast-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, InertiaBlast.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's InertiaBlast.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-InertiaBlast, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
